hypotheses.N1_every_axis_beats_sign_null: Every cleaned tail axis has empirical maximum-eigenvalue p at most 0.05 under 128 channel-sign nulls.
hypotheses.N2_every_axis_beats_pairing_null: Every cleaned tail axis has empirical maximum-eigenvalue p at most 0.05 under 128 coefficient-to-form pairing nulls.
hypotheses.N3_concentration_exceeds_sign_null: Every axis's top-four energy exceeds the 95th percentile of its sign-null distribution.
hypotheses.N4_pca_coordinates_are_spectrally_privil: The mean top-four energy of the four PCA axes exceeds 128 random rotations of the same output subspace.
hypotheses.N5_at_least_one_robust_cleaned_spike: At least one axis has p at most 0.05 under both sign and pairing nulls.
